sources: https://www.cityofpierre.org/200/Campground-Information (City of Pierre, read 2026-11-21): 'Open year-round, Griffin Park Campground is located on the southern edge of Griffin Park, adjacent to the scenic Missouri River. The campground features 16 parking spaces that can accommodate all sizes of camping vehicles. Renovated in 2004, each camping pad is constructed of asphalt chips, features electrical hookups, and is delineated by parking blocks.'; 'A camper dump station is located at the west end of the campground. Potable water is available at the dump station to fill holding tanks between April and November. You will also find showers, bathrooms, and a storm shelter near the campground, which is open from May through October.'; 'The city does not take reservations for the campground. It is on a first-come, first-served basis.'; '$25 per night during May through October. $16 per night from November through April, but please note that bathroom facilities and potable water are unavailable during this period as they are winterized.'

https://www.cityofpierre.org/DocumentCenter/View/456/Tent-and-RV-Camping-Final-Policy-PDF ('Camping Rules at Griffin Park, Effective: 1.26.21', read 2026-11-21): 'Fee per night (May 1 to October 31) is $25/night. Camping fee from (November 1 to April 30) is $16/night. The City does not take reservations.'; 'take envelope from black mailbox ... place payment in lock box'; 'Length of stay is limited to fourteen (14) days'; 'There shall be NO tent camping at the Griffin Park campground.'; 'Camp sites have 30 and 50 amp power. A dump station with water is located on site. Restrooms with showers are located east of the tennis courts.'; 'water is off and restroom closed November 1 to May 1'; 'No camp fires allowed.'; 'Director of Parks and Recreation at 773-2527'
Google Maps place panel via headless browser 2026-11-21: 'Griffin Park Campground' 4.2 stars (16 reviews), +1 605-773-2527, website the cityofpierre.org campground page

Esri World_Imagery 44.3574,-100.3425 (hw 120 m) with marked points, 2026-11-21: the 16 angled back-in stalls line the south edge of a gravel lot (pedestal row ~44.3579,-100.3432 to ~44.3575,-100.3423); south of them a lawn with tree clumps (a dense clump in front of the east half), then a ~30 m sand beach; the Missouri (Lake Sharpe) water edge is ~60-65 m from the stalls

note: City of Pierre campground on the south edge of Griffin Park near downtown, a row of 16 asphalt-chip back-in stalls facing the Missouri River (Lake Sharpe) across a lawn and a sand beach. No tents and no campfires. --Claude
summary: City page + 2021 rules sheet + Google + imagery: 16 back-ins, 30/50 A, $25 May-Oct / $16 Nov-Apr (winterized), FCFS self-pay, 14-day limit, no tents, showers/dump, year-round. Riverfront DOWNGRADED to riverview (stalls ~60-65 m from the water across lawn, tree clumps and a sand beach). Groups manual; phone '' -> 605-773-2527.
flags: WATERFRONT: riverfront -> riverview (DOWNGRADE, not an --AWH value). The 16 stalls (pedestal row ~44.3579,-100.3432 west to ~44.3575,-100.3423 east; sites unnumbered on any source) sit at the south edge of a gravel lot; from their tails it is ~30-35 m of lawn to a sand beach and ~60-65 m to the Missouri (Lake Sharpe) water edge, beyond the ~50 m bound, and a dense tree clump stands in front of the east half. The stored evidence said ~30-50 m to the water; that figure is the distance to the beach sand, not the water. Counter-case for the reviewer: if the sand were counted as the high-water edge, the west stalls would be ~30-35 m over open lawn.
